files.name: slashskills-probe-humanize
files.description: Edit or audit prose for generic AI patterns while preserving voice, meaning, uncertainty, and format. Use when writing sounds synthetic, repetitive, over-polished, or unlike its author.

files.name: slashskills-probe-landing-page
files.description: Design, build, audit, or repair evidence-led landing pages by coordinating message, proof, structure, interface, and verification. Use when a marketing page must perform a clear job.

files.name: slashskills-probe-mobile-first
files.description: Audit and repair responsive interfaces from measured narrow-screen evidence without changing product intent. Use when a page clips, overflows, stacks poorly, or fails on touch.

files.name: slashskills-probe-remove-ai-slop
files.description: Audit and remove AI-like design and copy defaults using rendered evidence and confidence scoring. Use when reviewing an interface for generic or repetitive patterns.

files.name: slashskills-probe-skill-creator
files.description: Create, improve, merge, and validate portable Agent Skill packages with adaptive workflows and behavioral evals. Use when authoring or reconstructing SKILL.md packages.
